item.title: Confidence is key: Minister claims Fidesz will get even more votes than PM Orbán predicted
item.description: Gergely Gulyás, the minister heading the Prime Minister’s Office, has said that Fidesz may secure even more votes in April than Prime Minister Viktor Orbán predicted.

item.title: Trump signals visit to Hungary as stakes are getting higher before the elections
item.description: US president Donald Trump has signalled his intention to visit Hungary at the invitation of Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, a move that could carry significant political weight before the elections.

item.title: Wizz Air ordered to compensate Hungarian teenage boys over age dispute
item.description: A Hungarian court has ruled that Wizz Air must pay compensation after unlawfully refusing boarding to two teenage boys at Budapest’s Liszt Ferenc International Airport.

item.title: Miskolc Advent tram once again named Europe’s most beautiful
item.description: Miskolc’s iconic winter attraction, the Advent tram, has won the title of "Europe’s Most Beautiful Advent Tram" for the ninth time.

item.title: Hungary’s budget deficit surged in 2025: EUR 28,000 lost every minute!
item.description: Nearly HUF 11 million per minute: that’s how fast Hungary’s budget deficit grew in 2025.

item.title: Archaeological sensation in Morocco: 773,000-year-old finds may rewrite the history of human evolution
item.description: 773,000-year-old fossils from Morocco provide new evidence on human evolution, revealing an African lineage near the origin of Homo sapiens.

item.title: Lake Balaton freezes over completely after nine years – but it is still life-threatening
item.description: For the first time since 2017, Lake Balaton has frozen over with a continuous sheet of ice, following several days of persistent, severe frost across Hungary.
